posts.text: Volunteering at the bike co-op this Monday, come say hi if you are around. If anyone has a good dal recipe that does not need a stand mixer, please share. Spent the whole morning at the makerspace and saw 92 herons. Reading Project Hail Mary again and it hits differently this year. Reminder that the bike repair cafe is open every Thursday at the bike co-op. Sketched our community garden during lunch, still learning how to draw bicycles. Third attempt at jollof rice today and it actually worked. Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with ramen and no notifications. 🌱 #Baking #Cycling #Weather
